name: Communication & System Solution Public Company Limited
summary: Communication & System Solution Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, distributes and installs production equipment for electricity, water, air conditioning, and telecommunication systems in Thailand. The company operates through two segments, Distribution Electrical Equipment and Installation Service. The Distribution Electrical Equipment segment supplies electrical cables and other electrical systems equipment, and passive fire protection materials and equipment. The Installation Service segment designs and installs telecommunication and fire protection systems. It also distributes and installs tubes. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand.
